description:
Pedal Culture. Just Easier.

The Electric Gravel Bike That Still Rides Like a Croix de Fer

Creating the perfect electric gravel bike means finding the balance between natural ride feel and intelligent pedal assistance.

After years of development, countless prototypes and thousands of test miles, the Genesis Croix de Fer 60 strikes that balance perfectly.

Built on the legendary Croix de Fer platform, this premium electric gravel bike delivers all the capability, comfort and versatility the Croix de Fer is renowned for, with discreet electric assistance when you need it most. Whether you're tackling steep climbs, riding into relentless headwinds or extending all-day adventures, the Mahle XS system provides smooth, natural power that complements your ride rather than dominating it.

When the assistance is switched off, the Croix de Fer 60 rides just like a traditional gravel bike, preserving the responsive handling and unmistakable ride quality that has made it an adventure cycling icon.

Designed for gravel riding, bikepacking, endurance events and everyday commuting, the Croix de Fer 60 helps you ride further, explore more and enjoy every mile.

Key Features

Legendary Croix de Fer Platform ? Built on the iconic adventure bike, combining proven geometry with discreet electric assistance.

Mahle X20 Rear Hub Motor ? Delivers up to 65Nm of smooth, natural torque for steep climbs, headwinds and longer adventures.

Mahle XS SmartBike System ? Lightweight, fully integrated electric drive system that preserves the handling and feel of a traditional gravel bike.

Natural Torque Sensor ? Bottom bracket-mounted sensor delivers intuitive pedal assistance that responds instantly to your effort.

Virtually Drag-Free Performance ? With the motor switched off, the X20 hub creates almost no resistance, giving you the ride feel of a non-electric bike.

Integrated Mahle eShifters ? Easily change assistance levels from the hoods or drops without taking your hands off the bars.

Mahle SmartBike App Compatible ? Customise controls, monitor battery life and record every ride through your smartphone.

Reynolds 725 Steel Frame ? Heat-treated steel frame delivering exceptional comfort, durability and the signature Croix de Fer ride quality.

Shimano GRX Gravel Groupset ? Gravel-specific drivetrain and hydraulic disc brakes provide reliable shifting and confident braking across mixed terrain.

Amplitude Carbon Fork ? Lightweight carbon fork enhances comfort, precision and control on every ride.

Adventure Ready ? Designed for gravel riding, bikepacking, endurance events, touring and everyday commuting.

Ride Further with Confidence ? A premium electric gravel bike that combines classic steel ride quality with intelligent electric assistance for limitless adventures.

Pedal Culture. Just Easier.
